method.cache: New task-private HOME/TMPDIR/modules per invocation. No global page-cache eviction; default case emits no PCM. Module/PCH/stat-cache preparation and cleanup charged in complete API wall.
method.preprocessed_fixture: Prepared once from synthetic source with the same explicit target; its creation is excluded only in diagnostic preprocessed control, never presented as a production speedup.
method.metrics: Probe child wait4 user/sys and monotonic wall by stage; parent prepare/spawn/EOF/cleanup separate. CPU metrics are not a kernel trace or full waiting attribution. Independent task stage medians are not additive.
method.privacy: Only synthetic source and safe numeric/hash facts. Raw compiler/engine/config/power logs and all caches stay local.
